CITY COUNCIL 5:00 PM SPECIAL MEETING

CITY COUNCIL 5:00 PM SPECIAL MEETING

CITY HALL COUNCIL CHAMBER
38300 SIERRA HIGHWAY, SUITE B
PALMDALE, CALIFORNIA
TUESDAY, JANUARY 14, 2020
04:30 P.M.
AGENDA NO. 1475
www.cityofpalmdaleca.gov
WELCOME
NOTICE: This meeting will be webcasted live at www.cityofpalmdale.org and broadcasted live on Spectrum Channel 27.
NOTE: Materials related to an item on this Agenda submitted to the Council or any of its Authorities after distribution of the agenda packet will be available for public inspection at themeeting and after themeeting in the City Clerk's office, located at 38300 Sierra Highway, Ste. C during normal business hours. Those items provided by others at the meeting will be available in the City Clerk's office during normal business hours.
SPEAKER FORMS: &nbspFor record keeping purposes and in the event that staff may need to contact you, we request that a speaker's form, located on the table in the foyer, be completed and deposited with the City Clerk. This will then be public information. Please note that you are not required to complete this form or state your name and residence in order to speak. A three-minute time limit will be imposed on all speakers other than staff members.
In accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990, if you require a disability-related modification or accommodation to attend or participate in this meeting, including auxiliary aids or services, please call the City Clerk's Office at (661) 267-5151 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting.
Your courtesy is requested to help our meeting run smoothly. If you'll be kind enough to follow these simple rules, we can make the best possible use of your time and ours:
Please refrain from public displays or outbursts such as unsolicited applause, comments, cheering, foul language, or obscenities.
Any disruptive activities that substantially interfere with the ability of the City Council to carry out its meeting will not be permitted and offenders will be requested to leave the meeting.
Please turn off or mute your cell phones and mobile devices.
1. CALL TO ORDER 5:00 P.M. CLOSED SESSION MEETING.
2. ROLL CALL: MAYOR HOFBAUER, MAYOR PRO TEM LOA, COUNCILMEMBERS BETTENCOURT, CARRILLO, AND BISHOP
3. PUBLIC COMMENTS ON CLOSED SESSION ITEM:
4. PRESENTATION BY CITY ATTORNEY of the following item to be discussed in Closed Session:
4.1 The reason for holding a closed session is to allow the City Council a general discussion of the salaries, salary schedules, and/or compensation paid in the form of fringe benefits of its employees with the City's designated representative. Recent personnel changes and possible future realignment will also be discussed.
City Designated Representative: John J. Murphy, City Manager
This Closed Session is being held pursuant to the authority of California Government Code Section 54957.6.
5. CLOSED SESSION.
6. ANNOUNCEMENT BY CITY ATTORNEY of item(s) discussed in Closed Session.
7. ADJOURN 5:00 P.M. CLOSED SESSION MEETING.
8. CALL TO ORDER 7:00 CC/SA/PCA MEETINGS.
9. PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE AND MOMENT OF SILENCE IN HONOR OF OUR TROOPS.
10. ROLL CALL: MAYOR / CHAIR HOFBAUER, MAYOR PRO TEM / VICE CHAIR LOA, COUNCILMEMBERS / DIRECTORS BETTENCOURT, CARRILLO, AND BISHOP
11. PRESENTATIONS:
11.1 Palmdale Animal Care Center representative will present a cute critter that is available for adoption from our local Animal Care Center.
11.2 Presentation by Mayor and Council of a commendation to the Highland High School Football Team for their great success in the 2019 football season.
12. PUBLIC COMMENTS ON CONSENT CALENDAR, AND NON-AGENDA ITEMS:
Staff Recommendation: Move to approve the Consent Calendar.
13. WAIVER OF FULL READING OF RESOLUTION(S) and ORDINANCE(S):
Staff Recommendation: Move to waive full reading of the Resolution(s) and/or Ordinance(s) to be considered and voted on at this meeting. (Voice Vote - Requires a majority to waive.)
14. CONSENT CALENDAR: NOTICE: All matters listed under the Consent Calendar will be enacted by one motion unless an item(s) is pulled by Council, in which case the item(s) will be removed from the Calendar and will be considered separately following this portion of the Agenda.
